purpose: Bounded generalized-grid accuracy/cost comparison on the original two training parents

kplib.weight_policy: Full generated coordinates, uniform full weights, then time-reversal-only reduction. Never use spatially reduced weights with ISYM0.

selection: Choose lowest tested min_distance BELOW80 passing BOTH existing Gamma8 and internal d80 anchor on BOTH parents, with every denser tested grid also passing. Anchor itself must pass Gamma8; it is not eligible as a candidate without a denser internal reference.

timing.baseline: Fresh Gamma7 on the same allocation/node and unchanged INCAR
timing.old_run_timings: context only, never used as a claimed speedup
timing.claim_scope: Exploratory two-parent paired timings, no general performance guarantee

adoption: Recommend for this pilot only if accuracy gates and full/TR representation check pass, and median wall time is at least10 percent lower on BOTH parents. Otherwise retain Gamma7 or record insufficient evidence.
